findings.source: dai.sol permit: bytes32 digest = keccak256(abi.encodePacked("\x19\x01", domainSeparator, keccak256(abi.encode(PERMIT_TYPEHASH, owner, spender, value, nonces[owner]++, deadline))));
findings.issue: The struct hash and the EIP-712 digest are hashes of raw memory: _10 = _9 = mem[64] (no store to slot 64 in between) and mem[64] = _9 + 224 are not propagated, so 'mem[mem[64] + 32 len _9 - mem[64] + 290]' is not seen to be mem[_9 + 256 len 66] = 0x1901 ++ _6 ++ _12; the same hashes resolve in DOMAIN_SEPARATOR(), where mem[64] is a constant.
findings.rule: With mem[64] proven >= 128 (stores at mem[64] + k cannot alias slot 64), copy-propagate _x = mem[64] and the last store 'mem[64] = _9 + 224'; then sha3 over a range whose words were all written becomes sha3(PERMIT_TYPEHASH, owner, spender, value, _8, deadline) and sha3(Bytes(2, 0x1901), _6, _12).

findings.decompiled: const deploymentChainId = 0 / _2 = chainid and sha3(0x8b73c3c6..., ...) / if not chainid: _6 = 0 else: ... _6 = sha3(...)
findings.source: dai.sol: uint256 public immutable deploymentChainId; bytes32 private immutable _DOMAIN_SEPARATOR; block.chainid == deploymentChainId ? _DOMAIN_SEPARATOR : _calculateDomainSeparator(block.chainid)
findings.issue: Both immutables read as 0, so the cached-separator branch becomes 'chainid == 0 -> 0'.

notes: solc 0.7.6 build, 230 lines. All 22 ABI functions compared in full (name, symbol, version, decimals, PERMIT_TYPEHASH and deploymentChainId as constants). No semantic error found: auth, the invalid-address checks, burn's and transferFrom's allowance logic with the max-allowance exemption, the unchecked balance updates next to the checked totalSupply (_add) as in the source, and the permit nonce, deadline, owner != 0 and signer checks all match. No source loops and no whiles. P10: burn/transferFrom print the balance read through SSA copies in both arms of the allowance ifs (_18 = _16, _16 = _14).
summary: Faithful, compact token text; the only notable defect is the permit digest left as a hash of raw memory, plus the immutables artifact.
